comparison.basis: the adaptive model's own fixed-depth heads: same weights, same training run, the only difference is whether the exit policy runs
comparison.verdict: the adaptive policy matches the best fixed head's macro-F1 (0.5474 at 512 bytes) while reading 116 bytes on average, 23% of the fixed cost

sweep_context.caveat: budgets larger than the adaptive model's 1024-byte ceiling are not a like-for-like comparison and are reported here only as context
